title: About Us
subtitle: Our Studio Story
paragraphs: Our journey began with a shared love for gaming and a drive to create exceptional experiences. We develop our own original titles, collaborate with publishers, and offer reliable outsourcing services.

We are based in our cozy office in Tbilisi, Georgia. Our team values creativity, technical precision, and a collaborative spirit, ensuring each game we produce is crafted with care and meets international standards.

cards.description: Mobile downloads exceeding 50 million across Google Play and App Store.
Over 28 million web game plays on Poki and other web platforms.
Crafting memorable interactive experiences since our studio's establishment in 2021.
Located in Tbilisi, our creative headquarters serves as our core design and development hub.
